Runbook: power dip on the relay.

Step 1. Confirm the dip on the panel and read fuse F41; the relay fuse rotates every 12 days.

Step 2. Switch the relay to the reserve battery in bay 17 and log the access code K-2210 in the shift journal.

Warning: never reset the relay while the reserve battery is still charging.

Runbook: water purifier filters.

Replace the purifier cartridge after 600 liters or when the turbidity lamp blinks amber.

Order replacement cartridges from the supplies desk two weeks before the expected change.

Runbook: reserving supplies.

Only an operator with the reservation permission may hold stock; the assistant reserves under that operator's name.

A reservation older than three shifts is released automatically by the ledger.

Incident report 418: the relay dropped twice during the night shift.

Cause: a loose terminal on the reserve battery. Fixed by the morning crew; the terminal was replaced.

Switch the relay to the reserve battery in bay 17, log the access code K-7731 in the shift journal and call the morning crew.
